details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:29578-29593 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The successor PR-state seed defaults to state=unknown/merged=false and swallows timeline/PR-fetch/implementation-PR-predicate failures, writing that into PR_STATES_JSON before check-wave-status.
  WHY: A closed successor whose PR merged but whose lookup failed is classified closed-without-merge, so any_failed is set and the judge can open a duplicate redo. Severity disagreement: sonnet-5_5 rated NIT, while gemini, minimax, luna and glm rated MAJOR. glm noted this matches the pre-existing classification and is not a regression. Merged at the highest severity (MAJOR mapped to high).
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:29561,29578-29593 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The successful adoption log line (outcome=adopted) and the seed fallback do not record that PR_STATES_JSON was seeded with defaults (for example pr_state_seed=unknown), and no LINKED_PR_CROSS_REF_REJECTED line is logged on this path.
  WHY: Operators cannot tell a failed lookup from a verified merged=false, so the duplicate-redo case cannot be diagnosed from logs. Raised as a NIT or hardening suggestion.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:29526-29540 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The reconcile loop makes one paginated REST timeline read per tick for each closed, unmerged, non-ai:merged issue with no reissue.
  WHY: The extra calls are bounded, the cost is documented, and the reviewer called it a cost note rather than a defect (NIT).
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:29587-29588 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The seeded state/merged values come from _jq_field with no domain check, so unexpected values such as "null" or empty would be seeded verbatim.
  WHY: Raised as a hardening suggestion only: constrain to ^(open|closed|merged)$ and ^(true|false)$.
- CI pre-push gate (tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py, tests/test_orchestrate_lib.py, shellcheck) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash, anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The pre-push gate attributed failures in tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py, tests/test_orchestrate_lib.py and shellcheck to this change.
  WHY: Reviewers disagreed on severity and confidence. gemini rated it MAJOR with confidence 5. glm rated it MAJOR with confidence 2 and could not map the failures to a code site. sonnet rated it NIT with confidence 1 and could not map them either. CI shards were still in progress. Merged at the highest severity.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Pre-push gate and CI must be green; the gate reported tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py, tests/test_orchestrate_lib.py and shellcheck as failures caused by this change.
  expected_change_site: tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py, tests/test_orchestrate_lib.py, scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh
  confidence=1
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  EVIDENCE: The poller-string splits in test_files_touched_scope_guard.py (~1383-1385) do not touch the new code, and the failures could not be mapped to a diff line. CI shards were still in progress.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~29579-29592 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: If the successor is closed without ai:merged, a failed timeline lookup or PR fetch is treated as merged:false and written into PR_STATES_JSON before check-wave-status.
  WHY: On a transient API failure, check-wave-status reads the entry as closed-without-merge. This is the same fail-open behaviour as the existing reconcile loop (~29482-29511). The window is narrow, and no LINKED_PR_CROSS_REF_REJECTED line is logged on this path.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~29526-29540 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Each tick makes one paginated REST timeline read for every qualifying closed issue with no reissue.
  WHY: The calls are bounded, and the cost is documented and audited. It is not a defect.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: Pre-push gate and CI must be green; the gate reported tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py, tests/test_orchestrate_lib.py and shellcheck as failures.
  Expected change site: tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py, tests/test_orchestrate_lib.py, scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh
  Evidence of absence: The failures could not be mapped to a diff line, and CI shards were still in progress. The copilot-pull-request-reviewer failure is environmental. | severity=NIT | confidence=1
- HARDENING: log a pr_state_seed=unknown or LINKED_PR_CROSS_REF_REJECTED line in the fallback (~29592), about 2 lines. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:29555-29576 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The successor PR lookup initializes _rb_reissue_pr_merged to false and swallows lookup failures, defaulting to merged:false in PR_STATES_JSON.
  WHY: If the PR actually merged but the lookup fails, check-wave-status reads the issue as closed-without-merge, triggering stall recovery or duplicate work.
- CI (Pre-push test gate): tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py, tests/test_orchestrate_lib.py, shellcheck | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Pre-push test failures and a shellcheck failure are attributed to this change.
  WHY: Merging with test regressions or lint violations compromises the orchestrator's contract.
- HARDENING: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh line 29592 — log pr_state_seed=unknown in the RB_REISSUE_ADOPTION line, about 2 lines. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:29578-29593 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The successor's PR_STATES_JSON entry is seeded unconditionally with state=unknown/merged=false whenever absent. The `|| echo ""` (29582), the empty-PR continue (29583), the `|| continue` after fetch (29585) and the `|| continue` after the predicate (29586) all fall through to the seed at 29592.
  WHY: check-wave-status (29624) then classifies the closed successor as closed-without-merge, sets ANY_FAILED=true, and the wave judge opens a duplicate redo. The new test test_rb_reissue_adoption_seeds_successor_pr_state (tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:8692) does not exercise the failure paths.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:29578-29593,29561 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A successful adoption whose PR lookup silently fails is indistinguishable in logs from one that found merged=false. The outcome=adopted line gives no hint that defaults were seeded.
  WHY: The success path never reports pr_state_seed=unknown|mapped|missing, so the duplicate-redo issue cannot be diagnosed from logs.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:29579-29592 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The successor PR-state seed treats failed or inconclusive PR lookups as confirmed merged:false, initializing unknown/false and swallowing timeline and PR-fetch failures.
  WHY: If the successor's PR merged but the lookup fails, check-wave-status receives merged:false with a closed issue. reconcile_wave_issue_status then classifies it as closed, marks the wave failed, and can trigger another redo.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:29578-29592 (also 29582, 29584-29585, orchestrate_lib.py:3634-3640, 2363-2368, 3651-3652) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: When an adopted successor is closed without ai:merged and its PR evidence cannot be confirmed, the seed writes {state: unknown, merged: false}. Merge truth is unconfirmed, not false.
  WHY: check-wave-status classifies the closed successor as "closed" and sets any_failed=True, which reproduces the duplicate-redo incident when the adoption tick coincides with a transient API failure. This is not a regression, because the pre-existing pr_merged=None path classified identically.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh (7160-7341, 29462-29601); shellcheck, tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py, tests/test_orchestrate_lib.py | severity=MAJOR | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Three gate failures are attributed to this change, but no CI shard had completed at review time and none could be mapped to a code site. The copilot-pull-request-reviewer failure (custom_instructions_too_large) is environmental.
  WHY: A real shellcheck failure would block the merge-train gate, and a real test assertion break would be a contract regression. The editor must map each failure or show it is inherited or environmental.
- HARDENING 1: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:29592 — emit an RB_REISSUE_ADOPTION ... pr_seed=inconclusive warning line, about 2 lines.
- HARDENING 2: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:29587-29588 — constrain the seeded values with ^(open|closed|merged)$ and ^(true|false)$, about 3 lines. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
